```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Require{$n\ge 1$}
\Procedure{Maximum}{$A[1..n]$}
      
      \State $v \gets A[1]$ \Comment{지금까지 본 원소의 최댓값}
      \For{$i \gets 2$ \textbf{to} $n$}
        \If{$A[i] &gt; v$}
          \State $v \gets A[i]$
        \EndIf
      \EndFor
      \State \Return $v$
    \EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
